description: What a person said, objected to or agreed with: rule-labelled stance sentences from their own words. author + topic ("what did Tom Lane object to in SIGFPE handling"), or message_id for one thread (every participant, or add author). Each: verbatim sentence, message_id, url, date, from, stance (opposes, concerned, supports, commits), cue, source (rule or commitfest status). Labels are a rule's guess: read the sentence. counts by stance; messages_read (max 400); complete=false when a cap or budget_ms cut it. Sentences without a cue word are not returned.
name: said
